name: Brineglass Vigil
image_style: A striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper rendered as a translucent salt-glass diorama: frosted sea-glass panels, etched acetate, granular mineral texture, thin wire inlays, and soft projected light create layered depth without painterly brushwork. The mood is wind-scoured, antiquarian, contemplative, and gently absurd, like a maritime museum display that has come quietly alive. Use abyssal blue-green, smoked violet, chalked shell, weathered copper, and tiny controlled flashes of vermilion; keep the material mostly matte with selective milky refraction and edge glow. Preserve a broad, dark, nearly empty upper edge for the desktop bar and a calm shadowed region on the right for widgets. No lettering, logos, watermark, frame, border, or interface elements.
scene: Exactly one striking 16:10 landscape desktop wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, set on a remote tidal saltworks at pre-dawn. Broad evaporation ponds mirror a dim moon, with timber sluice gates, low stone evaporation huts, stacked salt baskets, wind-bent reeds, and a narrow causeway leading toward a distant watchtower. Historically grounded workers in rough coastal clothing quietly rake crystallized salt under lantern light. In the lower-right, Space Ghost is unmistakable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, standing rigidly on a sluice platform while attempting to measure the salinity of a tiny brine pool with an absurdly elaborate brass laboratory apparatus. His cape is clipped neatly to a post so it cannot touch the salt. The workers continue their dignified routine with restrained bewilderment; the humor comes only from his solemn, misplaced scientific professionalism. Keep the upper half spacious and low-detail, with cool mist and empty sky, and leave the lower-left water dark and calm for widgets. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
